effects.label: Curtain of Slumber

abilities.description:
Puts forth a shield known as the Curtain of Slumber, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
The Curtain of Slumber's DMG Absorption is based on Layla's Max HP and absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% effectiveness. When the shield is deployed, Layla will have Cryo applied to her briefly.

Night Stars and Shooting Stars
While the Curtain of Slumber is active, it will create 1 Night Star that will be attached to it every 1.5s. When a character protected by this shield uses an Elemental Skill, 2 Night Stars will be created. Night Stars can be created once every 0.3s in this way. A maximum of 4 Night Stars can be accumulated at any one time.
Once the Curtain of Slumber has accumulated 4 Night Stars and there are opponents nearby, these Night Stars will transform into homing Shooting Stars that will be fired off in sequence, dealing Cryo DMG to any opponents hit.
If the Curtain of Slumber's duration ends or it is destroyed, the Night Stars will disappear. If they are already being fired off as Shooting Stars, these Shooting Stars will last until this wave of shots ends.

New Night Stars cannot be created until the previous wave of Shooting Stars has been fired completely.
_curatorNotes: ↻ 2026-08-14 — the stand-in summon is retired. "Curtain of Slumber" was a zero-effect `summons[]` entry whose only jobs were to give this instant cast a 12s active window and to put a labelled bar on the chart. Both now have their own field: `activeDuration` on the ability and `label` on the shield Effect, which the shield lane renders. `summons[]` is back to meaning a thing left in the world. Bar geometry is unchanged apart from the spawn offset, which the shield window never had.

abilities.name: Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker

_curatorNotes: Starlight Slug tick series authored 2026-08-17 from gcsim internal/characters/layla/burst.go `func (c *char) Burst`: `for delay := burstStart; delay < 12*60+burstStart; delay += 90` — 8 tasks on a fixed 90f period (interval 90/60 = 1.5s), each queueing one attack. Not a coordinated attack: the cadence is a Core.Tasks.Add timer, independent of the active character.

firstTickDelay 1.3 = (114f − spawnsAt 36f) / 60. 114f is the landing frame from cast start: burstStart 36 + tickRelease 56 + tickTravel 22 (`c.Core.QueueAttack(ai, …, tickRelease, tickRelease+travel, cb)`; travel defaults to tickTravel = 22, overridable by the `travel` param). Matches the gcsim-frames-diff §5 observed row 114f / 90f × 8.

scaling 8.368 = zz_layla.dm.go `burst` array index 9 (talent level 10) = 0.083678 of Max HP. Sidecar docs/curation/talents/layla.json row 'Starlight Slug DMG', 10th value '8.4% Max HP' — same number at genshin-db's display precision; gcsim's is used.
stat 'hp': the tick is `FlatDmg: burst[c.TalentLvlBurst()] * c.MaxHP()` with no Mult — Max-HP scaling, not ATK.
ICD left bare (standard): ai has ICDTag ICDTagElementalBurst / ICDGroup ICDGroupDefault, and the measured row's verdict is 4/8 standard. Durability 25 = 1U.
C6 Radiant Soulfire increases Starlight Slug DMG by 40% but changes neither the cadence nor the tick count, so no gated variant is authored.

passives.name: Sweet Slumber Undisturbed
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote from `damage hp 1.5 target:enemy` to `buff self burstFlatDmg scaling hp 1.5`. gcsim a4() returns 0.015 * MaxHP as flat damage added to each Shooting Star hit (no event trigger — value is computed inline). Shooting Stars are burst-tagged in gcsim, so burstFlatDmg fits. Trigger remains manual; should be `passive` once the trigger pass runs (always-on; no ICD).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive "Sweet Slumber Undisturbed" (A4) — effects[0] (buff burstFlatDmg, scaling hp 1.5) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/layla/asc.go:25-30` — `a4()` returns `0.015 * c.MaxHP()` as a flat addend, computed inline with no event, and it is consumed at `shield.go:130` (`FlatDmg: c.a4()`) on the Shooting Star `AttackInfo`. ⚠️⚠️ **That `AttackInfo` is `AttackTag: attacks.AttackTagElementalArt` (`shield.go:123`) — SKILL-tagged, not burst.** The host's curator note ("Shooting Stars are burst-tagged in gcsim, so burstFlatDmg fits") is FALSE; only Starlight Slug (`burst.go:40`) is `AttackTagElementalBurst`. Retain — gcsim `shield.go:121-131` gives the Shooting Star `AttackTagElementalArt` with `FlatDmg: c.a4()` (`asc.go:29`, 1.5% Max HP), so the stat is `skillFlatDmg`, ⛔ never `burstFlatDmg`; the old note's burst-tag claim was wrong and must be deleted, not carried. ⚠️ The stat over-claims onto the skill's own cast hit (`skill.go:32-45`, `AttackTagElementalArt`, `skill[TalentLvlSkill]` mult), which the kit does not buff — this is the BRIEF's "scoped to one named ability inside a class" shape. It is authored anyway because three shipped precedents the brief itself names do exactly this and carry no caveat: Cyno's `normalFlatDmg` covers only Pactsworn Pathclearer's normals, Cyno's `skillFlatDmg` only Duststalker Bolts, Dehya's `skillFlatDmg` only Molten Inferno. ⚠️ If the curator prefers the strict reading, the fallback is RETIRE — but then Cyno and Dehya must go with it, because the shape is identical.
